blocks.text: London's cult-favorite Bread Ahead, famous for its viral Crème Brûlée Doughnut and generously filled brioche doughnuts, has opened its first Philippine bakery at Glorietta 4 in Makati, bringing its signature pastries, sourdough breads, pizzas, and Manila-exclusive Ube Doughnut to the city.
